wording.notes_de: Holzbau außen: Glasdach mit Gefälle zur Rinne, Pfostenträger auf Fundament, Holz unbehandelt oder lasiert.
wording.prompt_en: Outdoor timber construction on the terrace, posts on metal post bases, a slightly sloped glass roof with a gutter; the house facade stays unchanged.
wording.judge_en: Posts stand vertically on the ground; the roof attaches to the house wall above windows and doors and slopes away from the house.
